name: web-database-monorepo
description: AI Tools Hub / MCP & Agent Registry monorepo

scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @web-db/schema run build && pnpm --filter @web-db/renderers run build
scripts.pipeline:report: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @web-db/pipeline run report
scripts.pipeline:run: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @web-db/pipeline run run
scripts.site:build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @web-db/site run build
scripts.test: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r run test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r run typecheck
